instruction: Navigate to the United Club membership information page on the website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the United Club membership page. Evaluator verifies URL contains 'united.com' and either 'united club' or 'club membership' patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_tab_info getter to extract the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match properly handles both string and dict result formats
Expected patterns correctly verify both domain (united.com) and page topic (united club or club membership)
ALL-patterns-must-match logic (AND) is semantically correct for this navigation task
Data flow from getter to metric is correct: getter extracts URL, metric verifies patterns
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor issue: Regex patterns are case-sensitive. Consider using re.IGNORECASE flag or converting URLs to lowercase before matching to handle edge cases like 'United.com' or 'Club'
The pattern 'united.*club|club.*membership' will match URLs containing 'united...club' OR 'club...membership', which correctly verifies the page is about United Club membership
